args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy - rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an elevated error rate of 0.18 after the latest deploy. Rolled back to the most recent healthy production release, v2.3.0, in all regions. Rollback completed successfully; service status is rolled_out on v2.3.0.

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

1. **Investigated**: `checkout-api` was on v2.3.1 in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), unhealthy with an error rate of 0.18. Deployment history showed v2.3.1 was the only unhealthy production release; the most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0** (v2.2.9 was also healthy but older).

2. **Rolled back**: Rolled `checkout-api` back to **v2.3.0** in all production regions. The rollback completed successfully.

3. **Opened incident**: Created SEV2 incident **INC-0001** ("checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy - rolled back to v2.3.0"), which paged the on-call engineer, describing the failure and the rollback action.

4. **Verified**: Post-rollback status confirms `checkout-api` is now healthy on v2.3.0 in all regions with a normal error rate (0.002).
